title: Which of a county's seven districts kept a free fire engine within ten minutes of fewer than three quarters of their homes across 2026, for its 2027 to 2031 community risk management plan, read from where each free engine stood minute by minute; with the rural on-call stations' crewed-but-off-the-run hours and each district's false alarms from fire alarm apparatus at non-domestic premises
subdomain: network-analysis (a fire and rescue service's emergency cover over its road network: the share of homes a free engine could reach within the attendance standard, averaged over a year)
prompt_shape: scorecard against a threshold: each of seven districts' 2026 cover against the 75 per cent line and whether it is named, beside each rural on-call station's hours off the run with four or more firefighters booked (and of those with no crew or watch commander), each district's false-alarm actuations at non-domestic premises 2022 to 2026 and their rate, and a chart
